plugins.name: issue-evaluator
plugins.description: Evaluate GitHub issues against the current repo: diagnose, check fix status, analyze code style, provide reproduction and fix plans, review pull requests, scan for high-value issues, and run adversarial review via Codex after fixing.

plugins.name: worktree-cleaner
plugins.description: Clean up git worktrees whose branches have merged/closed PRs, with optional removal of no-PR worktrees.

plugins.name: harness-engineering
plugins.description: Design, audit, and harden the scaffolding around autonomous agents — the harness that constrains inputs, externalizes state, verifies every step, and recovers from failure. Commands: /harness-design, /harness-audit, /sprint-contract, /resilience-plan.

plugins.name: idea-to-ship
plugins.description: End-to-end flow from a vague idea to shipped code: Socratic requirement mining, architecture design, adversarial design review, staged implementation, adversarial code review, and test strategy. Each stage lands a markdown artifact under .idea-to-ship/<slug>/ so stages compose and can resume.

plugins.name: auto-updater
plugins.description: SessionStart hook that auto-updates plugins installed from local directory marketplaces when the source repo has a newer commit.

plugins.name: agent-playbook
plugins.description: Operator-facing distillation of the best-practice literature (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Anthropic engineering, Peter Steinberger). Commands: /bootstrap-project-memory, /context-audit, /tool-review.

plugins.name: secret-scanner
plugins.description: Scan staged/uncommitted/recent changes for leaked secrets - cloud keys (AWS, Google), VCS tokens (GitHub, GitLab), AI API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic), payment keys (Stripe), Slack/Twilio/SendGrid tokens, JWTs, private keys, DB connection strings, and generic password/token assignments. Deterministic Python scanner plus LLM-assisted false-positive triage. Read-only.

plugins.name: skill-stats
plugins.description: Track skill invocations via PostToolUse hook and display usage statistics. Run /skill-stats to see call counts, last-used times, daily trends, and identify unused skills.

plugins.name: antifragile
plugins.description: Antifragility audits. /antifragile-agent checks plugin/hook/skill robustness; /antifragile-system checks the target project for resilience gaps (dependency fallbacks, error handling, single points of failure, data safety, observability).
